author: Samuil Petkov
new_mathematical_refinements: The strict spectral window now gives the edge five-cycle bound `sigma_uv >= 2k-1`. At degree six and order 50, the upper six-cycle moment bound is strict because the localizing matrix is positive definite. Both displays and the exact enumeration script agree; the same 266 degree profiles survive. The introduction explicitly credits the published Moore-graph spectra and retains the Capy Build and Wilbanks–Annie counterexample records. Eigenspace notation and the disclosure heading are clearer. The abstract is unchanged.
formalization_scope: Appendix I distinguishes imported structural and finite-matrix certificates and the graph-independent LP optimum from the paper-side graph-distance identification, trace bridge, integral-slack and deletion results. The new cycle refinements are written results supported by the specified exact checks, not newly released Lean theorems.
